question: Will the U.S. and Iran return to war before December 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo: US is conducting limited 'defensive' strikes near Hormuz roughly every few days (Nov 2 Qeshm/Hengam/Bandar Abbas reports; Nov 6 Qeshm air defense), 88 projectile strikes since July. But recent strikes are mostly on islands with no reported deaths, while the criterion requires a lethal strike on MAINLAND Iran in Nov 3-30. Hawkish pressure (Netanyahu, Miller as CoS, lame-duck window) vs Trump downplaying strikes post-midterm rout and Qatar-mediated talks. A lethal mainland hit (e.g., Bandar Abbas launchers) in 23 days is a coin-flip-minus; resolver leniency on islands is an upside risk. No matching human market found (Polymarket 'US strikes Iran by' resolved in June).
calls.dossier:
- Nov 2 2026 (Mon evening): US 'limited defensive' strikes on Qeshm Island after IRGC fired on US aircraft; explosions also reported on Hengam Island and mainland Bandar Abbas (CBS live, NBC, Euronews). No casualty figures reported. Falls BEFORE window (window is after Nov 2).
- Nov 6 2026 (Fri night): US struck air-defense system in Suza area of Qeshm Island; Trump called it 'minor', 'knocked it out in 15 minutes' (Euronews, Al Jazeera, NBC Nov 7). No deaths reported. Iran claims MQ-9 shot down over Qeshm.
- Al Jazeera Nov 7: 88 projectile strikes since hostilities resumed July 2026; 11 ships attacked in week to Nov 6, three sank; analysts describe 'pendulum between war and negotiations'; Trita Parsi: pressure for deal dissipates post-election; Stephen Miller named chief of staff.
- Bloomberg Nov 4: Trump says no immediate plans for strikes after Democrats' midterm landslide; Trump acknowledged war contributed to GOP loss (PBS).
- Fox Nov 5: CENTCOM preparing for possible strikes; Netanyahu pressing Trump to attack post-midterms. NYT Oct 24: US believes Iran plotting attacks on US officials.
- Trump says 'a lot of progress' in Qatar-mediated talks; Iran demands sanctions relief, end of blockade; US simultaneously announced $20M reward for Iran nuclear info.
- Earlier precedents: lethal US strikes Feb-Mar 2026, May 7 2026, September 2026 strikes; Oct 8 Trump pledge of no strikes before Nov 3 midterms.
- Resolution note: resolves off credible reports of a LETHAL (>=1 death) kinetic US strike on MAINLAND Iran; vessels in Hormuz excluded; islands (Qeshm, Hengam) arguably not 'mainland' - ambiguity.
- Event window: after Nov 2 2026 -> before Dec 1 2026; as of Nov 7 ~18% elapsed (23 days remain).
- Markets: no matching human market found; Polymarket 'US strikes Iran by...?' resolved June 2026.
- Searched but not found: casualty counts for Nov 2/Nov 6 strikes; confirmation of mainland targets in Nov 6 strike; Kalshi contract on this window.
calls.reference_class: Weeks during the July-Nov 2026 intermittent US-Iran hostilities in which the US conducted a confirmed-lethal strike on Iranian mainland territory

calls.reasoning: US limited strikes on Iran are ongoing at high tempo (Nov 2 and Nov 6), but both recent strikes were small, centered on Qeshm/Hengam islands (mainland Bandar Abbas only mentioned as explosion area), with no reported deaths — so they apparently haven't qualified. Resolution needs a lethal strike on mainland Iran by Nov 30, ~23 days left. Upside: escalation pressure (Netanyahu, Iranian vows of unrestrained response, ship attacks, lame-duck window); a US casualty event would very likely trigger lethal mainland retaliation as in July (Bandar Abbas/Chabahar). Downside: Trump chastened by midterm rout, Qatar-mediated talks, deliberate 'minor' calibration, and lethality/mainland reporting thresholds. No matching market: Kalshi doesn't list strikes; Polymarket only has 'US invade Iran before 2027' at 11% (different contract).

calls.reasoning: Since Nov 2 the US has carried out repeated 'defensive' strikes (Nov 2-3 on Qeshm/Hengam and the Bandar Abbas mainland area; Nov 6-7 on Qeshm), but none of the reports I found clearly show a lethal strike on the mainland after Nov 2. The Bandar Abbas hit came ~22:10 UTC Nov 2, a borderline case, with no reported deaths. Strikes recur every few days and target coastal air defenses, so a lethal hit on the mainland coast in the remaining ~23 days is plausible; Netanyahu pressure and a lame-duck window before January push up. Against: Trump calls the strikes minor, played down escalation after the midterm rout, Qatar talks continue, and deaths must be credibly reported. Base rate from Mar-Sep 2026: most months had lethal mainland US strikes; October (pause) had none. Markets: Polymarket 'US strikes Iran by' contracts lack the lethal and mainland requirements, so they don't match; Kalshi has Iran contracts, none matching.

- Nov 2, 2026 ~5:10pm EST (~22:10 UTC; ~01:40 Nov 3 Iran time): US 'limited defensive' strikes on Qeshm and Hengam islands and the Bandar Abbas mainland area, retaliating after an Iranian missile was fired at a US aircraft. No deaths reported in CBS/CNBC/Euronews coverage (CBS live blog, Euronews Nov 3, WSJ via IranIntl Nov 3). Timing is borderline for 'after November 2'.
- Iran's IRGC claimed it downed US MQM-170 and MQ-9 drones near Qeshm (Washington Times, Nov 3).
- Nov 3: Democrats won the midterms in a landslide, a result tied to anti-war sentiment. Nov 4: Trump said no immediate plans to strike Iran (Bloomberg).
- Nov 6-7: US struck an air-defense system in the Suza area of Qeshm Island; Trump called it 'minor', 'we are not fighting', and said Iran 'wants a deal' (CNBC, Euronews, NBC Nov 7). No casualties reported.
- Netanyahu pressed Trump by phone for renewed strikes; Trump would not commit (PBS). Analysts say Trump may act before the new Congress is seated in January (Bloomberg). Fox reported CENTCOM preparing for possible strikes (Nov 5).

- Ship attacks continue in the Persian Gulf (CBS). Strikes on vessels in Hormuz do not count.
- History: lethal US strikes on mainland Iran occurred in Feb-Apr (war), May 7, July (6+ consecutive nights; 38 killed that month across Hormozgan, Khuzestan, Sistan-Baluchestan, Bushehr; APA, Jul 17), and September. Trump paused strikes Oct 8 until the midterms. Roughly 5 of 8 months since March had a qualifying-type event; the current regime is low-intensity defensive strikes mostly on islands.
- Resolution note: requires a US strike on Iranian MAINLAND territory (islands like Qeshm/Hengam likely do not count), with at least one death per credible sources. Event window: after Nov 2 -> before Dec 1, 2026; as of Nov 7 about 18% elapsed.

calls.reasoning: US limited 'defensive' strikes keep happening every few days (Nov 2, Nov 6), but they hit islands (Qeshm/Hengam) with no reported deaths, so nothing qualifies yet. 23 days remain in the Nov 3-30 window. A qualifying event needs a lethal hit on mainland Iran, most plausibly coastal air defenses or launchers near Bandar Abbas, or retaliation after US casualties as in July. Restraint signals (Trump calling the strikes minor after the midterm rout, Qatar talks) roughly balance escalation pressure (Netanyahu, lame-duck window, Iran's vow of an unrestrained response, ship attacks). No matching human market found.
calls.reconciliation: All three runs agreed at 0.44 and drew on the same evidence. Factual checks from the dossiers: the Nov 2 Bandar Abbas-area strike (~22:10 UTC Nov 2) falls on or before the window boundary, had no reported deaths, and the question stayed open, so it does not qualify. The Nov 6 strike was on Qeshm island, with no deaths reported. Whether islands count as mainland can't be settled here, so it stays a small upside risk. The rest is judgment: the strikes recur often but look deliberately calibrated as minor, and the post-midterm political signals favor restraint. I land slightly below the runs at 0.40, keeping a substantial chance of an escalation spiral before the new Congress is seated.
